basic_profile.bio: An avid gamer and collector based in Melbourne, Australia. I'm passionate about Animal Crossing and Magnum Quest, often trading and strategizing with fellow enthusiasts. I work as a freelance graphic designer, which allows me flexible hours, usually online in the evenings and late nights. I'm single and enjoy attending local gaming meetups. I dislike overly complex trading protocols and prefer straightforward exchanges.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a deep understanding of game mechanics and in-game economies, largely self-taught through years of playing and experimenting with different strategies. My graphic design skills are honed through a combination of formal education and hands-on client projects.
